author: GameSpot
description:
Tune in on March 11th, at 6:30pm PT for the 2026 IGF Award Show.

The Independent Game Festival celebrates boundary-pushing indie teams and student creators with major recognition and cash prizes across categories including the Seumas McNally Grand Prize, Excellence in Audio, Design, and Visual Art, among others. 

Follow our curator page on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6861411-GameSpot-Official/
title: Independent Game Festival Award Show 2026

author: GameSpot
description:
Tune in at 6:30pm PT on March 12th for the 26th Annual Game Developers Choice Awards. 

The Game Developers Choice Awards are the premier accolades for peer recognition in the digital games industry. Each year, the Choice Awards recognize and celebrate the creativity, artistry and technical genius of the finest developers and games created in the last year.

Follow our curator page on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6861411-GameSpot-Official/
title: Game Developer Choice Awards 2026 Livestream
